ios.desc:
CineMath is the professional calculator suite designed specifically for filmmakers, video editors, and production professionals.

Twelve essential tools with frame-accurate precision and intuitive modern design.

PROFESSIONAL CALCULATIONS:
• Speed Percentage - Calculate frame rate conversion percentages with precision
• Target Length - Determine clip length adjustments for perfect timing
• Target Bitrate - Calculate optimal compression settings for any file size
• Upload Time - Estimate transfer times for large video files
• Time to Data - Convert runtime to storage requirements
• Data to Time - Calculate maximum runtime from available storage
• Time to Film - Calculate required film stock from recording time
• Film to Time - Calculate recording time from available film stock
• Aspect Ratio - Professional resolution and ratio calculations with smart pixel rounding
• Timecode Calculator - Add, subtract, multiply, and divide timecodes
• Timecode to Frames - Convert timecode to precise frame counts
• Frames to Timecode - Convert frame counts to timecode values

PROFESSIONAL FEATURES:
• Frame-accurate calculations for 23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 59.94, 60 fps and custom rates
• Film format support: Super 8mm, Super 16mm, Super 35mm, 65mm, and IMAX
• Smart Pixel Rounding Engine - Automatically rounds to broadcast standards and encoding-compatible values
• Calculation History with advanced search and organization (Premium)
• Professional Sharing - Export calculations as formatted text (Premium)
• Bulk Operations - Select and share multiple calculations at once (Premium)
• Dark and light mode support with professional design
• Offline operation - no internet required
• Universal app supporting iPhone, iPad, and Mac (Catalyst)
• Professional precision for demanding workflows

PERFECT FOR:
• Film and video editors
• Post-production professionals
• Cinematographers and directors
• Analog film production planners
• Content creators and YouTubers
• Broadcast engineers
• Film students and educators
• Anyone working with video timecode and technical specifications

CineMath eliminates guesswork with precision calculations trusted by professionals. 

Download free and upgrade to CineMath Professional for advanced features.
Privacy-focused: All calculations performed locally on your device.

quotes.text:
Over the last 15 years I've worked as an AE/Editor, DIT, Colorist, Online Editor & Post Supervisor and based on my experience I've built a tool that I hope will be useful for some of you!

It's a cinema calculator (aspect ratios, target speeds, target bitrates & more...) called CineMath and it's available for free download in the Apple App Store.

I would be immensely grateful for any feedback and hope that it helps someone in their workflow!
